subject: Lightning round: 20-min commit verification for Q1 forecast
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Lightning round: 20-min commit verification for Q1 forecast

Team —

Quick ask: I want to run a short "lightning round" to lock amounts, SKUs, explicit next steps, and probabilities for the handful of Acme deals that are inflating our Q1 commit. No long meetings — 20 minutes total.

Please do the following before 10:30am PT today: 
- Verify deal amount matches signed SOW or latest quote in the HubSpot deal record (update if off).
- Confirm primary SKU(s) and quantity line items (if unknown, mark as "quote pending").
- Set a single next step with owner and target date.
- Adjust close probability to a defensible value and add one sentence justification in the deal comments.

I've exported a small extract (attached) with the subset I pulled — columns: deal_id, amount, sku_summary, next_step, probability, last_touch. Mark updates in HubSpot and reply here with quick bullets on anything you change.

Attachments: cr_20280117_deal_extract.csv, acme_notes_0117.pdf

This is high-impact for the weekly forecast — appreciate rapid responses.

Thanks,
Soojin

> Team —
> 
> Quick ask: I want to run a short "lightning round" to lock amounts, SKUs...

Done: I updated two deals in the extract — notes below. I left comments with the source (quote PDF) and the line-item breakdown.

- ACME-022: Amount reduced from $420k -> $385k. Sales quoted a discount for implementation services; updated amount and added comment: "Adjusted to reflect signed quote v3 attached 20280111."
- ACME-031: SKU split: added "Edge Accelerator" x3 and marked professional services as separate line. Previously lumped under "Platform".

I also set next steps for both deals: owner = Marissa, next step = "Finalize SOW review" due 2028-01-20. Probabilities: ACME-022 -> 65% (reduced), ACME-031 -> 80% (confirmed).

Uploading my working CSV now (snippet attached). If anyone sees a conflict with the signed docs, shout.

Ben

Date: Tue, 17 Jan 2028 09:50:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lightning round: 20-min commit verification for Q1 forecast

Thanks Ben — quick confirms from my side: 

- ACME-022: Confirmed amount $385,000. I uploaded the signed quote to the HubSpot attachments and left a 1-line justification in the deal timeline: "Signed quote v3 matches amount; finance notified."
- ACME-031: Confirmed SKU split; I added product codes (EA-01) to the SKU field and set next step owner to myself with due date 2028-01-20.
- ACME-045: Flagging this one as "quote pending" — AE indicated pricing still being finalized with procurement. Set probability to 20% and note "awaiting procurement PO".

I'll run a quick filter in HubSpot to reconcile any other deals with missing SKU details and post follow-ups here.

—Marissa

Sales Manager, Enterprise

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Jan 2028 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lightning round: 20-min commit verification for Q1 forecast

Tiny ops note: I noticed our probability bands in HubSpot are a bit permissive — some deals are sitting at 70% with no buyer PO. I'm going to create a quick validation rule and a saved filter so we can find deals where probability > 60% but last_touch > 21 days or no signed doc attached.

Link to the filter (apply if helpful): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/filter/forecast-bakeoff-2028
Jira to track the validation rule: SUP-1245 (I'll add acceptance criteria).

If anyone objects to me running the rule this afternoon, say so now. Otherwise I'll run it after 3pm PT and share the exceptions list here.

Rishi
Director, RevOps
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Jan 2028 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lightning round: 20-min commit verification for Q1 forecast

Perfect — thanks for the quick updates. Summary/action items: 

- Ben: confirmed ACME-022 amount -> $385k; ACME-031 SKU split (EA x3) — thanks for CSV and notes.
- Marissa: uploaded signed quote + set next steps for ACME-022 and ACME-031; marked ACME-045 as quote pending (prob 20%).
- Rishi: go ahead with the validation rule; please share exceptions before we finalize tomorrow's forecast.

I'll close the loop and send the final reconciled list to finance and the forecasting channel by EOD. If anything else pops up, post here or ping me.

20-minute sync is optionally available at 11:00am PT if anyone wants to run through edge cases — otherwise we progress asynchronously.

Thanks again — this is exactly the clarity we needed for the weekly commit.

Soojin
